legend: Broad-universe scan for ANY stock (not just defensive sectors) showing early accumulation signs, using the same criteria as accumulation_screen.py.
Only tickers scoring >= 2/4 - your shortlist to dig into further.
Every ticker scanned, successful or not, sorted by score.
Count (0-4) of criteria met: MA150 turned up, range-bound (<=15% over 60d), up/down volume ratio >=1.3x, OBV rising.

Screening tool only, not investment advice. A high score flags a technical pattern worth investigating - it says nothing about the company's fundamentals, valuation, or risk. Always research individually before acting.

oversold.title: Oversold Quality
legend: Finds stocks trading well below their all-time high (oversold) that still show fundamentally healthy businesses - cheap because sentiment turned, not because the business broke.
% below all-time closing high, between 25% and 85%.

Count of criteria met, out of however many had data available (shown as e.g. '7/10'). 12 possible: revenue growing YoY, earnings growing YoY, revenue trend healthy, historically profitable, positive FCF, ROE > 8%, ROIC > 7%, ROCE > 7%, Debt/Equity < 150, interest coverage > 3.0x, analyst upside positive, low dilution.

TRUE if the MOST RECENT annual period grew or was roughly flat vs the prior one - deliberately allows a business that dipped years ago but has since stabilized or resumed growth, not just monotonic growers.
TRUE if net income was positive in all but at most one of the available annual periods (usually ~4 years) - a track record check, separate from whether profit is currently growing.
NOPAT / Invested Capital. NOPAT = EBIT x (1 - effective tax rate, estimated from Tax/Pretax Income, or a 21% fallback). Invested Capital = Total Debt + Equity - Cash. Threshold: > 7%.
EBIT / Interest Expense. A solvency check that's somewhat less distorted by industry capital structure than Debt/Equity alone. Threshold: > 3.0x.

NOT sector-adjusted - capital-intensive sectors (utilities, REITs, financials) carry structurally higher leverage as a matter of business model, not necessarily risk. Cross-check against Interest Coverage and the sector column before treating a leverage flag as disqualifying.
Cumulative % change in diluted share count from the oldest to the newest annual period available. Negative = buybacks (shrinking share count). 'Low Dilution?' passes if this is <= 3%.
Only tickers scoring >= 6 on the quality score.
Every ticker that passed Stage 1, regardless of quality score.

yfinance's per-ticker fundamentals occasionally come back incomplete due to Yahoo-side rate limiting. A missing field is excluded from scoring, not counted as a fail. If most rows show blank fundamentals, increase FUNDAMENTALS_PAUSE and re-run.
Screening tool only, not investment advice. A high score flags a pattern worth investigating, not a recommendation - always check WHY a stock is down before assuming it's an opportunity.
